newsitem.title: UK: Biocompatibles higher on Merrill buy note.
newsitem.headline: Biocompatibles higher on Merrill buy note.

text.p: Shares in Biocompatibles International Plc rocketed higher on Monday in further reaction to a Merrill Lynch buy note, issued on Friday, traders said.
The shares were up 92-1/2p at 1247-1/2 by 1118 GMT.

Merrill on Friday set an intermediate price target of 16.00 stg per share, saying the British healthcare technology group's profit outlook had improved since it embarked on a joint venture with specialist company Divysio in November.
But traders were unsure whether the rise would continue.
"It's a hairy stock," one said. "Nobody knows whether it will carry on up to 16 pounds."
